recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast black and white photograph of a glamorous female figure draped in a voluminous white feather boa, set against a stark black background. The composition features large-scale, vibrant gradient typography at the bottom and a vertical informational sidebar (obi strip) on the left.
coreVisualRelationships: Monochrome subject vs. vibrant magenta-to-purple gradient text
Soft, organic texture of feathers vs. sharp geometric letterforms
Vertical orientation of the subject vs. horizontal dominance of the base typography
Deep negative space surrounding the central figure
coreInvariants: High-key lighting on the subject's face and feathers
Linear color gradient in the primary display text
Ultra-thin weight for secondary display text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered vertically, occupying the middle third of the frame horizontally, scaled to full height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright white feather boa serves as the central luminous anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the illuminated face, follows the vertical line of the feathers down to the large gradient text, then moves left to the vertical sidebar.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive black negative space on the left and right of the subject to emphasize isolation and glamour.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast in the image; high saturation in the footer text against a zero-saturation background.

letterConstructionRules: Uniform stroke width for primary text
characterSpecificRedesigns: Superscript numeral for mathematical notation in secondary text
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Weight contrast (Bold vs. Hairline) within the same geometric family.
graphicDevices: Vertical sidebar (Obi strip) with mixed horizontal and vertical text
Subtle butterfly watermark in the sidebar background

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: Gotham or ITC Avant Garde Gothic
candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric structure and wide proportions of the primary display text.
Provides the necessary hairline contrast for the secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast black and white fashion photograph of a woman with long wavy hair, looking upward, draped in a thick, luminous white feather boa that covers her torso and flows down. The background must be solid black. Leave the bottom 25% of the frame clear for text.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place a large geometric sans-serif name in the bottom quarter with a magenta-to-violet horizontal gradient. Place a thin, white, hairline-weight mathematical formula in the middle-right negative space. Add a vertical pink and yellow informational strip on the far left edge.

verificationChecks: Does the large text have a smooth color gradient?
Is the secondary text visibly thinner than the primary text?
Is the subject lighting high-contrast (Chiaroscuro style)?

mustRedesign: Specific Japanese characters on the sidebar
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the gradient text is legible against the black background.
Check that the hairline text is not lost in the composition.
Verify the feather texture appears soft and detailed.
Confirm the vertical sidebar does not overlap the main subject's face.
recipe.reuseFormula: High-contrast monochrome subject + Large gradient geometric footer + Hairline secondary text + Vertical sidebar accent.
